question: The Revolutionary Socialist Party was established in ____.
solution:
The correct answer is 1940.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Revolutionary Socialist Party was established in 1940.
 
• It is a communist party in India.
 
 
• The party was founded on 19 March 1940 by Tridib Chaudhuri and has its roots in the Bengali liberation movement Anushilan Samiti and the Hindustan Socialist Republican Army.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Hindustan Socialist Republican Association was a revolutionary organization, also known as the Hindustan Socialist Republican Army.
 
 
• It was established in 1928 at Feroz Shah Kotla in New Delhi by Chandrasekhar Azad, Ashfaqulla Khan, and Bhagat Singh.
 
• The party was initially named Hindustan Republican Association (HRA) by Bismil when he formed it in 1924.
 
• A manifesto for the party was written by Sanyal titled ‘Revolutionary’. 
 
• Other prominent members of the party were Sachindra Nath Sanyal and Jogesh Chandra Chatterjee.
